title: Homepage
descript: Homepage is a modern dashboard for everything on your network: service links grouped by category, live widgets for Docker containers, disks, CPU and memory, bookmarks, weather and search. The layout is a set of YAML files in the application data folder, so it is easy to edit and back up.
release_note: 1. First release: Homepage 2.8.0 from Docker Hub as a non-root container. Service dashboard with Docker/disk/CPU widgets; YAML configuration in the application data folder.
important: Requires DockerEngine (installed automatically if missing). On first start the image writes example configuration files (services.yaml, widgets.yaml, bookmarks.yaml) to DockerAppData/homepagedocker/config; edit them and restart. The package sets HOMEPAGE_ALLOWED_HOSTS=* so the dashboard answers on the NAS IP and any reverse-proxy host name - keep it on the LAN or put an authenticating proxy in front. Plain HTTP.

github.description: A highly customizable homepage (or startpage / application dashboard) with Docker and service API integrations.

zh-cn.descript: Homepage 是给你的网络做的现代仪表盘：把服务按分类排成入口，配 Docker 容器、磁盘、CPU/内存的实时小组件，还有书签、天气与搜索。布局就是应用数据目录里的几个 YAML 文件，改起来方便、也容易备份。
zh-cn.important: 需要 DockerEngine（缺失时应用中心会自动安装）。首次启动会把示例配置（services.yaml、widgets.yaml、bookmarks.yaml）写到 DockerAppData/homepagedocker/config，编辑后重启应用即可。本包设了 HOMEPAGE_ALLOWED_HOSTS=*，让仪表盘能在 NAS IP 和任意反向代理域名下访问——请只在内网使用，或加一层带鉴权的代理。界面为纯 HTTP。
zh-cn.release_note: 1. 首个版本：基于 Docker Hub 的 Homepage 2.8.0，以非 root 容器运行。服务仪表盘，带 Docker/磁盘/CPU 小组件；YAML 配置保存在应用数据目录。

zh-hk.descript: Homepage 是給你的網路做的現代儀表盤：把服務按分類排成入口，配 Docker 容器、磁碟、CPU/記憶體的即時小元件，還有書籤、天氣與搜尋。版面就是應用資料目錄裡的幾個 YAML 檔案，改起來方便、也容易備份。
zh-hk.important: 需要 DockerEngine（缺少時應用中心會自動安裝）。首次啟動會把範例設定（services.yaml、widgets.yaml、bookmarks.yaml）寫到 DockerAppData/homepagedocker/config，編輯後重啟應用即可。本包設了 HOMEPAGE_ALLOWED_HOSTS=*，讓儀表盤能在 NAS IP 和任意反向代理網域下存取——請只在內網使用，或加一層帶鑑權的代理。介面為純 HTTP。
zh-hk.release_note: 1. 首個版本：基於 Docker Hub 的 Homepage 2.8.0，以非 root 容器運行。服務儀表盤，帶 Docker/磁碟/CPU 小元件；YAML 設定保存在應用資料目錄。

data_notes: `/app/config` (mounted from `DockerAppData/homepagedocker/config`) holds `services.yaml`, `widgets.yaml`, `bookmarks.yaml`, `settings.yaml` and the logs folder.
design_notes: **Config seeded by the image.** The first start copies example YAML files into the volume; the user edits them there.
**Host validation disabled deliberately.** `HOMEPAGE_ALLOWED_HOSTS=*` is required because the NAS is reached by IP, host name or reverse proxy.
limitations: - The layout is YAML; there is no web editor.
- Docker widgets read container state through the API only if you configure it; this package does not mount the docker socket.
- The UI is plain HTTP; use a TLS reverse proxy before exposing it to the internet.
